France Riots: Shops Damaged, Curfews Considered Amid Protests

Violent riots, vandalism, and looting have occurred across France, leading to significant damage to businesses. In response, the cities of Marseille and Lille saw football clubs Marseille and Lille close their shops. French Prime Minister has called for localized curfews in cities to help curb the unrest. Marseille has also banned protests amid the ongoing riots.
